This leads us to the next of Freud's major contributions to neuroscience: his realization that cognition is, at bottom, wishful.
That is from the new and notable Mark Solms, [The Only Cure: Freud and the Neuroscience of Mental Healing](https://marginalrevolution.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=a8306c39b3bcb217ab0d635997a1b404c39f91f4a0c5ba68f3c39695f8fd560e&blog_id=42693868&post_id=92772&user_id=262258391&subs_id=225460721&signature=b1da00c5388c123c284a3ade8bfa806d&email_name=new-post&user_email=ishan.mail@gmail.com&encoded_&email_id=71c21ad817db7ff69c47776f575f50ec). This is a good book for people who underrated Freud, or think he is a mere charlatan.
